articles.title: Related Secures $65M Refi for Office Property in L.A.’s South Bay
articles.narrative: Related Companies and Cruzan have secured a $64.7 million refinancing loan for The Torrance, an eight-story Class A office property in Los Angeles' South Bay. The loan was provided by Waterfall Asset Management and Delaware Life. The property, which is 93% occupied, was acquired by the current owners in 2017 for $106.8 million and previously refinanced in 2022.

data_points.project_notes: Property previously acquired for $106.8 million in 2017 and refinanced for $59.2 million in 2022.

articles.market_intelligence: The South Bay market is experiencing surging demand from aerospace and defense users for both office and industrial space. The Greater Los Angeles office market has an overall vacancy rate of 25.3% as of Q2 2026, while trophy properties have a 13.5% vacancy rate.

articles.title: Ares Buys Two Fully Leased Miami Warehouses for $109M
articles.narrative: Ares Management has acquired two fully leased industrial warehouses in Miami-Dade County from BGRE for a combined $108.7 million. The properties, totaling 372,619 square feet, were recently developed by BGRE and are fully occupied by strong tenants. This acquisition further expands Ares Management's growing industrial footprint in South Florida.

data_points.project_notes: The properties were completed between 2022 and 2023.

articles.title: Gaia Lands Another Extension for Williamsburg Apartments’ $48M Loan
articles.narrative: GAIA Real Estate has secured a second one-year extension for its $48 million loan on a multifamily property at 55 Hope Street in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, pushing the maturity date to August 2027. The developer acquired the 117-unit apartment building in August 2022 for $80 million and has since increased net operating income through active management and property enhancements. Despite interest from other lenders for a full refinancing, GAIA opted for the extension due to the current interest rate environment, citing a strong loan-to-value ratio and debt service coverage.

data_points.notable_features: Building was renovated in 2012 and previously utilized as a pencil factory. Features include coworking space and a refurbished rooftop.
data_points.project_notes: Property was acquired by GAIA Real Estate in August 2022 for $80 million. Hope Street Capital previously acquired the building for $17 million in 2010 and converted it from industrial to residential use.

articles.title: Membership Platform Patreon Renews 45K-SF Sublease at 75 Varick Street
articles.narrative: Patreon, a membership and monetization platform, has renewed its sublease for 44,661 square feet at 75 Varick Street in Manhattan's Hudson Square. The building, also known as One Hudson Square, is a key asset within the Hudson Square Properties portfolio, a joint venture between Trinity Church Wall Street and Norges Bank Investment Management. The renewal reflects a broader trend of increased leasing activity and rising rents in the Hudson Square neighborhood, driven by the city's AI sector growth.

data_points.address: 75 Varick Street, New York City, NY

articles.market_intelligence: Office rents in Hudson Square averaged $91.02 per square foot during the second quarter of 2026. Between 2024 and 2025, leasing volume in Hudson Square more than doubled year-over-year, and average office asking rents increased more than 17 percent over the last three years.

articles.title: Developer Ailanthus Files Plans to Build 400 Apartments at 424 Hoyt Street in Gowanus
articles.narrative: Developer Ailanthus has filed a rezoning application to construct a 17-story, mixed-use residential development at 424 Hoyt Street in Gowanus, Brooklyn. The project is planned to include 400 apartment units, with 100 to 120 designated as affordable, alongside a 46,000-square-foot public school and 14,000 square feet of commercial retail space. This development aligns with New York City's broader housing goals to address the significant need for new housing units, particularly affordable homes, in areas like Gowanus.

data_points.address: 424 Hoyt Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Proposed 17-story, 175-foot-tall building with a public school and commercial retail space.
data_points.project_notes: The 2.1-acre site was previously acquired by Two Trees Management in July 2008 for $7.7 million. Ailanthus has a ground lease at the site from Two Trees Management. The property currently has a one-story automotive repair building and vehicle storage facility.

articles.title: Partnership Underway on Seniors Housing Project in East Brunswick, New Jersey
articles.narrative: A joint venture between National Development and an affiliate of Benchmark Senior Living has commenced construction on Benchmark at East Brunswick, a new seniors housing project in Central New Jersey. The community will offer 87 units and 100 beds for assisted living and memory care residents, featuring a range of amenities. JLL secured $35.1 million in construction financing for the project, which is slated for completion in 2028.

data_points.notable_features: Amenities will include multiple dining venues, a theater, fitness center, salon and outdoor spaces.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers $11.4M Sale of Lower Manhattan Apartment Building
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of 196 Bowery, a seven-unit apartment building in Lower Manhattan's NoLita neighborhood, for $11.4 million. The property includes ground-floor retail space. Marcus & Millichap represented the seller, Bowery Square Corp., and procured the buyer, Javeri Capital.

articles.title: Cushman & Wakefield Negotiates $83M Sale of Whole Foods-Anchored Shopping Center in Doral, Florida
articles.narrative: Cushman & Wakefield has brokered the $83 million sale of Doral Marketplace, a newly constructed, 83,365-square-foot shopping center in Doral, Florida. The property, anchored by a prominent grocery store, was fully leased at the time of sale to a strong mix of national retailers. A high-net-worth family office, advised by Lincoln Property Co., acquired the asset from Atlanta-based SJC Ventures.

data_points.notable_features: Anchored by a prominent grocery store.

articles.title: HMF Americana Acquires Land from Harris Teeter in Metro Charlotte, Plans Build-to-Rent Development
articles.narrative: HMF Americana has acquired a development site in metro Charlotte from Harris Teeter, with plans to develop a 221-unit build-to-rent residential community. The project will feature cottage-style rental homes, including a portion reserved for residents aged 55 and older, and approximately 10,000 square feet of multi-tenant commercial space. Site work is slated to begin in October 2026, with vertical construction following in the first quarter of 2027 and initial move-ins expected in the third quarter of 2027.

data_points.notable_features: Includes cottage-style rental homes, with a portion reserved for residents age 55 and older. Additional land is available for future expansion.
data_points.project_notes: Site work is expected to begin in October 2026, followed by vertical construction in Q1 2027.

articles.title: JLL Arranges Sale of 356,514 SF Office Building in Orlando
articles.narrative: JLL Capital Markets has arranged the sale of Sea Harbor Office Center, a 356,514-square-foot office building in Orlando, Florida. Northridge Capital LLC sold the property to a joint venture between Duvalla Investments and Epoch Residential. The property's Planned Development zoning allows for future hotel or residential development, indicating potential for a significant repositioning or expansion of the asset.

data_points.notable_features: Located across from SeaWorld, features a full-service cafeteria, fitness center, two lobbies, and a five-story parking garage with 1,250 spaces, plus 380 surface spaces. Planned Development (PD) zoning allows for future hotel and/or residential development.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap brokers sale of net-leased bank in Dallas
articles.narrative: DP Investments LP, a California limited partnership, has acquired a newly constructed 2,300-square-foot net-leased bank property in Dallas from seller 3662 Investors LP, a Texas limited partnership. The seller also developed the property, which was built in 2026. Marcus & Millichap brokered the transaction, which involved resolving complex title matters and the seller agreeing to complete a new plat post-closing.

data_points.address: 3230 W Camp Wisdom Rd, Dallas, TX
data_points.project_notes: Seller agreed to complete processing of a new plat following the closing. Complex title matters were resolved during the transaction.

articles.title: CBRE closes sale of Sheetz convenience store in Gahanna
articles.narrative: A single-tenant Sheetz convenience store located at 495 Crescent Circle in Gahanna, Ohio, was acquired by 495 Crescent Circle Gahanna Ohio LLC for $3.4 million. The transaction was an all-cash 1031 exchange for the buyer. The property is secured by a 15-year triple-net ground lease with the convenience store chain, offering long-term income stability.

data_points.project_notes: Secured by a 15-year triple-net (NNN) ground lease.

articles.title: Greysteel closes $18.1 million sale of 142-unit apartment property in Cudahy
articles.narrative: Greysteel has brokered the $18.1 million sale of Cudahy Commons, a 142-unit multifamily property in Cudahy, Wisconsin. A private investor sold the asset to Peak Capital. The transaction highlights strong investor interest in stabilized multifamily housing, particularly within the Midwest, where a significant majority of investors plan to increase their exposure.
articles.market_intelligence: Greysteel's Mid-Year 2026 Investor Sentiment Pulse Check found that 84% of respondents plan to increase their Midwest multifamily exposure over the next 12–18 months. Yield and cash flow were the dominant motivation among Midwest-focused respondents (approximately 71%). Active private investors most frequently targeted $5–20 million transactions.

articles.title: Stream Realty Partners takes on leasing assignment for 11-property industrial portfolio across Chicago’s O’Hare submarket
articles.narrative: Stream Realty Partners has been selected to manage the leasing for an 11-property industrial portfolio in Chicago's O'Hare submarket. The portfolio encompasses approximately 1.1 million square feet across Franklin Park, Des Plaines, and Elk Grove Village. This assignment highlights the continued demand for well-located industrial assets in the O'Hare submarket, which benefits from its proximity to a major air cargo hub, extensive highway access, and a robust labor market, making it a strategic location for industrial users.

data_points.notable_features: Located within Chicago's O'Hare industrial submarket, benefiting from direct access to a major air cargo hub, extensive highway connectivity, and a deep labor pool.

articles.title: Global Holdings Lands $382M Refi for Midtown Tower
articles.narrative: Global Holdings has secured a $382.4 million refinancing loan for its 120 Park Ave. office tower in Midtown Manhattan. The new financing, provided by Wells Fargo and LBBW, replaces an existing $335 million loan from HSBC. This recapitalization follows a significant lease renewal by a major tenant, which occupies approximately 80% of the building, and will support a planned capital improvement program for the Class A asset.

data_points.address: 120 Park Ave., New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Class A building located next to Grand Central Terminal.
data_points.project_notes: The refinancing will facilitate a capital improvement program for the asset. The property was previously acquired by Global Holdings in 2008 from Altria Group.

articles.title: NYC Plans 215-Unit Bronx Apartment Building
articles.narrative: The New York City Department of Housing Preservation & Development (HPD) has filed plans for a 215-unit apartment building in the Melrose neighborhood of the Bronx. The proposed 20-story development, located on a city-owned lot, will also include 7,000 square feet of commercial space and various amenities. HPD has selected Procida Cos. and Nos Quedamos as developers for the project, which aims to advance the Melrose Commons Urban Renewal Plan by providing new affordable housing.

data_points.notable_features: Includes 7,000 square feet of commercial space, a community room, second-floor terrace, and roof terrace.
data_points.project_notes: The project requires the city to remove an 85-foot height limit for new multifamily developments in the vicinity and create an Urban Development Action Area Program for income-restricted and affordable housing.

companies_people.label: OWNER
companies_people.firm_name: New York City Department of Housing Preservation & Development (HPD)

articles.title: Northern New Jersey Shopping Center Changes Hands
articles.narrative: Adoni Property Group has acquired Highlands Village, a 60,614-square-foot shopping center in Basking Ridge, NJ, from Kushner Real Estate Group. JLL Capital Markets facilitated the sale and secured $12.2 million in acquisition financing for the buyer from an undisclosed life insurance firm. The fully leased, necessity-based retail center, anchored by Walgreens and the United States Postal Service, benefits from its location within The Hills at Basking Ridge master-planned community and recent leasing momentum.

data_points.notable_features: Anchored by Walgreens and United States Postal Service; located within The Hills at Basking Ridge master-planned community.

articles.title: Iconic Rancho Cordova Furniture Showroom Listed for Sale
articles.narrative: The former Beck's Furniture showroom and distribution center in Rancho Cordova, a prominent fixture along the Highway 50 corridor for nearly 50 years, has been listed for sale. The expansive 208,800-square-foot property, which includes both showroom and warehouse space, is being marketed by Cushman & Wakefield on behalf of the Beckinger Family Ownership. The property's institutional scale and community recognition are highlighted as key attributes for potential buyers.

data_points.notable_features: Features approximately 90,000 square feet of showroom space and 120,000 square feet of warehouse and distribution space, located along the Highway 50 corridor.
data_points.project_notes: The property served as a warehouse and distribution center for Beck's Furniture, which closed its doors in 2025.

companies_people.label: SELLER
companies_people.firm_name: Beck's Furniture & Sleep / Beckinger Family Ownership

articles.title: Tishman Speyer Trades Mountain View Office Building for $121.5M
articles.narrative: Tishman Speyer has sold 400 Castro Street, a fully leased Class A office building in downtown Mountain View, California, to Spear Street Capital for $121.5 million. Tishman Speyer originally developed the property in 2002 and has maintained full occupancy since its completion. The transaction is noted as achieving one of the strongest pricing outcomes for an office sale in the Mountain View market recently.

data_points.notable_features: Class A office building with expansive roof decks, underground parking, and views of the San Francisco Bay and coastal mountains. Centrally located with convenient access to highways and Caltrain.

articles.title: MBK Sells Anaheim Apartments To TA Realty For $147M
articles.narrative: MBK Real Estate has sold a 314-unit apartment community in Anaheim, CA, to TA Realty for $147 million, equating to over $468,000 per unit. The transaction highlights continued investor interest in well-located multifamily assets in Southern California.

articles.title: Live Local Act Projects Struggle To Get Fannie, Freddie, HUD On Board
articles.narrative: The Live Local Act, designed to promote affordable housing development, is facing challenges in securing financing from major government-sponsored enterprises and federal agencies. Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and HUD have reportedly been hesitant to provide funding for projects initiated under this act, indicating a cautious approach to new affordable housing initiatives.

articles.title: Landmark Properties Opens Student Housing Project: The Los Angeles Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Landmark Properties has opened a new student housing complex near the University of Southern California. The development offers a variety of unit types, ranging from studios to five-bedroom configurations, providing extensive housing options for students.

data_points.notable_features: Located near the University of Southern California.

articles.title: Why DivcoWest Is Advancing A New 19-Story Lab Development In Somerville
articles.narrative: DivcoWest has secured planning approval for a 19-story laboratory development in Somerville, Massachusetts. This approval comes despite a challenging life sciences market in Greater Boston, signaling the developer's confidence in the long-term demand for specialized lab space.

articles.title: Angels Sale To Stan Kroenke Reopens Land Deal Possibilities With City Of Anaheim
articles.narrative: The potential sale of the Los Angeles Angels to Stan Kroenke could reignite discussions with the City of Anaheim regarding the redevelopment of the land surrounding Angel Stadium. This transaction has the potential to unlock significant real estate opportunities in the area, which has been a long-standing point of interest for the city.

data_points.address: 2000 E Gene Autry Way, Anaheim, CA
